rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst with visible blastocoel, compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona consistent with 3AA; minor overinterpretation of side-specific detail from a single image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality well, though some links are somewhat generalized.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions generally follow from embryo quality and history; minor issues include some speculative framing around recurrent implantation failure and probability adjustment.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF practice on morphology, prognosis, and early ectopic surveillance, but recommendations such as ERA/immunology/thrombophilia workup are more controversial and not routinely guideline-supported after this history alone.

Provides practical next steps including proceeding with transfer, lifestyle optimization, early beta-hCG/ultrasound monitoring, and contingency planning, though future-workup suggestions are somewhat broad rather than tightly prioritized.
